protocol.train_return: sum of R_sys over each 64-slot training rollout
protocol.eval_return: sum of reconstructed full R_sys over fixed-seed deterministic evaluation
protocol.cr: completed / arrived within the corresponding metric window
protocol.delay: mean E2E delay of completed tasks in seconds
protocol.energy: system compute + transmit energy; housekeeping excluded by environment metric
protocol.cum_hl_mean_satellite: sum over slots of avg_health_loss across satellites
